evidence.citation: “Repeat the same blind evaluation 2–3 times, using a fresh, context-free runner for every run”; “After each run, check the live checkout and clean any leaked changes”; and, after fixing genuine skill defects, “rerun all cases to check for regressions.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The repeated evaluations address nondeterminism and reproducibility, while fresh runners, leak checks, independent judging, and regression reruns protect isolation and integrity. Under the supplied bar, these are necessary controls rather than materially unnecessary work.
